name: MPD
author: kokko
description: MPD player for the bar and a full panel: queue, library search, playlists, internet radio. Needs a running MPD; it speaks the protocol itself over TCP or a Unix socket, with idle push instead of polling.

barWidget.description: What is playing right now, with cover and transport buttons. Click opens queue, search, library and internet radio.

schema.label: MPD host
schema.description: Hostname or IP. A path or @name is a Unix socket. Empty follows $MPD_HOST, then 127.0.0.1.

schema.label: MPD port
schema.description: Ignored when the host is a Unix socket.

schema.label: MPD password
schema.description: Only if the server asks for one. Stored as plain text in shell.json.

schema.label: Cover folder on this machine
schema.description: The library as mounted here, for cover files: empty reads MPD's own mpd.conf, which only helps when MPD runs on this machine. Set it to a local mount when the address above points at another host, so folder.jpg covers are found. A path that is not a directory disables the fallback.

schema.label: Label format
schema.description: %tag% is substituted, [ ] drops out when a tag inside it is missing, [a|b] takes the first hit.

schema.label: Label width (pixels)
schema.description: How much room the label gets before it scrolls or is cut.

schema.label: When the label is too long
schema.description: scroll or elide.

schema.label: Play indicator in the bar
schema.description: A small spectrum while a track plays, the play state glyph when it does not. A click on the strip toggles playback, the middle button skips, the wheel does what `wheelAction` says.

schema.label: Cover thumbnail in the bar
schema.description: The cover as a small image in front of the label.

schema.label: Scroll wheel
schema.description: volume, seek, track or none.

schema.label: Card on hover
schema.description: Cover, progress and the big transport buttons as a card under the bar.

schema.label: Cover backdrop: presence
schema.description: 0 turns it off; higher values make the cover behind the lists more present (opacity, saturation and sharpness together) without covering the rows.

schema.label: Card on track change
schema.description: Briefly show cover, title and progress at the bottom.

schema.label: Simple card on hover as well
schema.description: Show the simple display instead of the card with controls.

schema.label: Notification on track change
schema.description: Desktop notification with cover, title and artist.

schema.label: Cover in the player
schema.description: How the band in the panel looks: classic (soft-blurred cover behind the panel), sharp (the cover stays an image), hero (cover as the card of the player), anchor (big cover, one control row), vinyl (cover inside a spinning disc), minimal (no artwork, one thin line), split (cover as a full-height column on the left). Switchable live.

schema.label: Desktop card
schema.description: Draw the music card on the wallpaper. It sits on the bottom layer, so it is visible where the desktop is not covered by a window.

schema.label: Desktop card size
schema.description: card or mini.

schema.label: Desktop card corner
schema.description: bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left or center.

schema.label: Desktop card layer
schema.description: desktop keeps it under every window; above floats it over them, which also survives fullscreen video.

schema.label: Dim the card when paused
schema.description: Fade the card while playback is stopped.

schema.label: New in the library (start screen)
schema.description: The section that answers what just entered the library. Off also skips its two queries.

schema.label: Recently played (start screen)
schema.description: The last albums this player touched, from the bridge's own cache.

schema.label: Favorites (start screen)
schema.description: The tracks you starred, newest first; the heading opens the whole playlist.

schema.label: Random (start screen)
schema.description: A few records from the whole library. Off skips the `list album` question, the slowest of the five.

schema.label: Genres (start screen)
schema.description: The biggest genres as doors into the genre tab. Off skips the `list genre` question.

schema.label: Rows per section (start screen)
schema.description: How many rows each section shows, 1-6. Genres stay at two. 4 or more scrolls the screen.
